h1: Bystronic and LVD-style press brake tooling — punches and dies
intro: EUROSTAMP tooling for two clamping systems with their own tangs. Bystronic and Beyeler press brakes with type R, RF and RF-A clamping take the punches here — straight and acute, gooseneck, sash and 24° flattening blades, 155 to 250 mm (6.10 – 9.84″) high — and the 55 – 65 mm dies from V6 to V60. LVD press brakes take the LVD-style punches 196 mm high and dies 90 or 130 mm high from V6 to V120, rated up to 340 t/m (114 US t/ft). Tell us the clamping of your brake and we confirm the tang; the DXF profiles are on the page.

faq.q: Type R or RF-A — which do I need?
faq.a: They are two Bystronic / Beyeler clamping systems with different tangs and punch heights — type R punches here are 155 mm high, RF-A punches 175 mm, and the 250 mm punches fit both. Look at the clamp or at the marking on a punch you already use, or send us a photo, and we match it.

faq.q: Can I use European-style tooling on my Bystronic or LVD brake?
faq.a: Yes, with adapters: the upper adapters 4192 (type R), 4193 (type S) and 4214 (RF-A) take European-style punches on a Beyeler ram, 4143 – 4146 on an LVD ram, and the lower adapters 4301, 4302 and 4304 / 4305 do the same for dies. They are on the holders and adapters page.

faq.q: Can we get the tools as DXF files for our CNC?
faq.a: Yes — every tool in these tables that has a DXF link can be downloaded straight from the page: the profile drawn in millimetres, ready to import into the tool library of a Delem, ESA or Cybelec control or into offline bending software. For the few tools without one, ask us and we get the drawing from EUROSTAMP.
